overlap: Both objectives cover the mutable-release-root check-then-use/TOCTOU boundary and handle-bound path resolution. The parallel E1 additionally covers Windows junction semantics and already owns E2 architecture mapping.
decision: RETIRE_OUR_E1_TO_CONSUMED_OVERLAP; DO_NOT_DUPLICATE_E2; treat the two E1 claims as one research family with complementary provenance, not independent replication.
consumed_findings: String/path-returning confinement followed by later path use is not a race-free primitive under concurrent untrusted mutation.
WP1111 remains accepted only at repository-hosted component-CI scope; this finding does not mint runtime/host/effect/completion credit.
A heavy Linux path library is not justified at the static snapshot boundary unless the clean-machine threat model explicitly includes attacker-controlled concurrent mutation.
next_action: Consume the parallel E2 when terminal and select a different non-duplicate Trigger-6 objective now.
